instruction.name: vmod.du
instruction.description: Compute the remainder of each unsigned 64-bit element in `a` divided by the corresponding element in `b`.

experiments.name: dependent chain with element-0 reset helper
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 20000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'vmod.du $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.d $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element 0 is extracted, forced back to the test dividend, and replicated; vadd.b baseline subtracted.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 20000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'vadd.b $vr0, $vr0, $vr0; vpickve2gr.d $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper with vadd.b replacing the variable operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Range over 16 dividend/divisor pairs; min 7.99 at 0/2, max 26.98 at 18446744073709551615/1. Sample uses 1/1.
